Chapter 721 - 721 Powerful Curse; Master!

Chapter 721 - 721 Powerful Curse; Master!

721 Powerful Curse; Master!

Thunderbolt Sect.

The tall Kadin was lying on his side on a beast leather chair, hugging a beautiful woman and drinking fine wine. He would occasionally let out a carefree laugh.

When Kadin drank another glass of fine wine, his body suddenly suffused with dense black gas.

Kadin’s entire body kept twisting, and then he let out a beast-like roar, bursting out with a powerful force.

The beauty beside him burst like a bubble, turning into a bloody mist that filled the sky.

The changes here quickly attracted the attention of the people from the Thunderbolt Sect.

When they saw Kadin’s pained expression, they could not help but exclaim in horror, “Sect Master, what’s wrong?”

However, Kadin was not in the mood to answer.

His eyes were bloodshot as he kept turning his head.

Then, he kept swinging his fists and palms in all directions.

One after another, the disciples of the Thunderbolt Sect were blasted into nothingness. They were so frightened that they kept running and screaming from time to time.

“Sect Master has gone crazy!”

“The sect master has gone mad!”

“Everyone, be careful!”

Their running and shouting seemed to have aroused Kadin’s interest in killing.

Kadin kept swinging his saber, bursting out with a mighty gale. He formed ferocious ravines on the ground.

A moment later, Kadin seemed to have used up all his strength, and his figure suddenly stopped.

Then, like a deflated balloon, he fell straight to the ground and lost all his vitality.

Kadin was dead!

The entire Thunderbolt Sect was completely destroyed.

Qiu Ziqian’s and Lin Yulian’s crisis was resolved.

…

Earth, Coiling Dragon Villa.

A crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Kadin has been cursed by you and has five-star hatred toward you.]

[Ding! Kadin was cursed by you and died because of his inner demons and broken soul.]

[Ding! You got the first kill of a level-five Universe cultivator. You’ve obtained 5,000,000 experience points.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he was stunned for a moment.

Then, he revealed a smile.

He had only cursed for a day.

He did not expect Kadin to die just like that.

In fact, this was normal.

One had to know…

The current Curse was at the Saint level.

Even Saint Lords could be cursed.

Kadin was only a level-five Universe cultivator, so how could he possibly resist?

From now on, would he curse his enemies every time?

Lin Fan frowned.

After all, Curse could only be used once a day.

The number of his enemies… was unknown.

He slowly raised his head and looked outside the Coiling Dragon Villa.

The Coiling Dragon Villa had displayed miracles several times in a row, and many rumors had already formed on Earth.

It was said that immortals lived in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

It was said that there was a saint in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

There were also people who said that the Coiling Dragon Villa was the residence of the great man, Lin Fan.

…

It was precisely because of these rumors that more and more people came to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Some of them had encountered difficulties and wanted to ask Lin Fan for help.

Some were curious…

Lin Fan had long since known about this.

However, he never paid any attention to it.

But now, his thoughts had changed.

Perhaps he could recruit some people and form his own force to better protect his family and the earth.

After all these years of research and development, Lin Fan had gained a certain level of understanding of Heavenly Eyes. Now, not only could Heavenly Eyes see the weaknesses of his enemies, but he could also use the safest and fastest way to deal with them.

In addition, he could also see the talent of others in various laws.

Lin Fan swept his gaze over. Not long after, he discovered a man with a soaring sword energy hidden within his body and a man with a raging flame suppressed in his heart.

Both of them were extremely talented in Sword and Fire Laws.

Even Lin Fan’s eyes lit up when he caught sight of them.

“How did I fail to discover them in the past… If they’re properly nurtured, perhaps they might really have some effect.”

At this moment, these two men were just like many people who wanted Lin Fan to show his spirit. They knelt down quietly on the ground.

After kowtowing for a long time, there was no response. Some people gradually became suspicious and discussed from time to time.

“Are there any immortals in this Coiling Dragon Villa?”

“Is it any use for us to kneel down like this?”

“I’ll leave after kneeling for another afternoon.”

“It’s better to rely on ourselves than others. Let’s go!”

…

Some people began to have doubts about the Coiling Dragon Villa because of everyone’s discussion. They slowly stood up and walked into the distance.

A short and thin man said, “Li Ke, we’ve been kneeling for more than half a month, but there’s no response at all. Let’s go back.”

Li Ke shook his head and said, “You can go back. I can only obtain a chance at cultivating with him… If he really exists.”

The short and thin man looked at Li Ke’s serious expression and knew that it was useless to persuade him. He sighed and said, “Alright, then I’ll go back first.”

…

On the other hand, the medium-sized Qin Menghu heard the discussions of the people around him and had the idea of leaving.

Just as he was hesitating whether to get up…

A dazzling golden light suddenly appeared in the sky.

Dazzling and resplendent, it was like a golden sun that had suddenly appeared in the sky.

It was Lin Fan.

When everyone saw him, the entire scene fell silent.

After a while, the people started kowtowing again.

“Please help me.”

“Please accept me as your disciple.”

“I beg you…”

Lin Fan looked at Li Ke and Qin Menghu, who were kowtowing like most people, and said, “Come in.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his hand and tapped lightly. Li Ke and Qin Menghu flew into the air like balloons and quickly headed toward the Coiling Dragon Villa.

This scene attracted the attention of many people.

The divine being in the Coiling Dragon Villa had appeared!

Suddenly, more and more people from all over the world gathered.

They wanted to use their sincerity to move Lin Fan. They wanted him to help them fulfill their wishes so that they could go to greater heights.

Regarding these…

Lin Fan did not care at all.

After he brought Li Ke and Qin Menghu into the Coiling Dragon Villa, he taught them a few simple cultivation methods. Then, he said to Lil Stone, “When you have time, guide them.”

Lil Stone agreed.

After Lin Fan left, Li Ke and Qin Menghu could no longer hide their joy. Their faces were all smiles.

They felt that in the Coiling Dragon Villa, they were constantly getting stronger with every breath they took.

In addition to the cultivation method that Lin Fan had taught them, they were confident that they could reach a height that they could never reach before.

Lil Stone looked at the two happy people and coughed lightly. He said, “You two, come with me.”
